description: Source code for AnthropicVertexHandler class implementing a provider for Anthropic's API on Vertex AI, including message creation, model configuration, and prompt completion.

classes.name: AnthropicVertexHandler
classes.description: A class that handles communication with Anthropic's API on Vertex AI, managing message creation, model configuration, and prompt completion.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the handler with provided options, setting up the AnthropicVertex client with appropriate credentials and region.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a message stream with the model, handling message filtering, tool integration, and streaming response parsing.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves and configures the model parameters, including support for 1M context beta and model info.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt synchronously using the model, returning the generated text or throwing an error.
